Projects

For Philippine local treasuries

ALTOS Automated Local Treasury Operations System

Much of the daily work in a Philippine local treasury is still done by hand, from receipts and cash books to monthly reports, so reporting is slow and errors are hard to catch. ALTOS is my answer to that gap. It automates the full cycle of public money: official receipts, remittances and deposits, checks and cash advances, the monthly reports of accountable officers, and collection targets and results. One database serves both a desktop application and a web application across the office network.

Collections subsystem

A subsystem of ALTOS for collections and their reports: official receipts, collectors and their OR series, remittances and deposits, the daily RCD, and the monthly RAAF and CRAAF.

ALTOS DisburseReady

Disbursements subsystem

A subsystem of ALTOS for disbursements and their reports: vouchers, checks, cash advances and their liquidation, the check register and disbursement reports.
